gauge_theory.state: Joint state (X_t,G_t): X_t is cubie state in reconstruction notation; G_t maps reconstruction coordinates into a persistent block frame.
gauge_theory.initialization: At the sole ordinary FB endpoint, enumerate the 24 whole-cube orientation representatives and 24 ordered Roux block frames. Require exactly one orientation+frame pair for which the first 1x2x3 block is solved and the opposite block is incomplete. No SB or later state may participate in gauge initialization.
gauge_theory.transport: For each explicit whole-cube rotation token x/x'/x2/y/y'/y2/z/z'/z2 after FB, update G_t with a precomputed rotation transport table. Face, wide and slice turns do not change G_t.
gauge_theory.transport_table: Must be derived before route scoring from asymmetric-state invariance fixtures, not hand-coded by guessed multiplication order.
gauge_theory.invariance: For a pure rotation token, applying the token to X and then the transported G must yield the same canonicalized asymmetric probe state as applying the old G before the rotation.
gauge_theory.frame_lock: The FB-identified ordered block frame is locked. Rotation transport moves only the gauge representative; it cannot choose another frame based on later fit.

phase_operator.FB: sole ordinary ROUX_FB line; prefix-only gauge initialization and first-block objective
phase_operator.SB_span: first maximal contiguous nonempty ROUX_SB-classified span after FB
phase_operator.SB_completion: first state inside the frozen SB span where both locked blocks are solved under transported gauge
phase_operator.CMLL: first nonempty ROUX_CMLL line after SB completion; objective in transported gauge; both blocks anchors
phase_operator.LSE: first maximal contiguous ROUX_LSE-classified span after SB completion; target last endpoint; both blocks anchors

null_foundry.attempt_statistic: max -log10(add-one upper-tail p) over G3 features in the attempt
